title: Nebulink
problem: New traders face complex platforms, unfamiliar terms, and few ways to practice without risking money.
overview: Nebulink brings stock and cryptocurrency trading, lessons, and a virtual trading simulator into one mobile app.
role: I was the sole designer, conducting interviews and usability tests and developing the identity, wireframes, and prototypes in Figma.
contribution: Research, Branding, Usability testing, UX/UI Design, Prototypes.

sections.title: The project

list: Guide beginners through onboarding and their first trades.
Keep market data and educational content easy to scan.
Provide a simulator for practice before trading with real money.

blocks: Learning tools need to sit close to the decisions they explain. The simulator offers a place to practice; forums and expert insights offer a place to ask questions.

sections.title: Understanding the user
blocks: Interview participants felt overwhelmed by trading and unsure how it worked. They wanted explanations they could use while learning the process.

list: No safe place to test trading strategies.

sections.title: Design Process
blocks: I explored each screen on paper before making wireframes. The home screen puts portfolio performance first, with access to trading tools and learning resources.

sections.title: Feedback
blocks: Participants asked for guidance and community support alongside trading tools.

sections.title: Purchase
blocks: The purchase flow shows the token, charges, and selected bank account before confirmation.

sections.title: Stock/Crypto
blocks: Each asset page brings together performance, ratings, related articles, and forums.

sections.title: Dashboard
blocks: The dashboard collects followed assets, categories to explore, and recent articles and discussions.

list: Adapt layouts to different screens and orientations.
Give forms clear labels, error messages, and a logical tab order.
Explain unfamiliar terms in plain language.
Test the trading and learning flows with users.
Use feedback to prioritize new tools.
Expand lessons to cover advanced strategies and market trends.
